notes.title: Major Update: Arctic Legacy
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone!
[/p][p]We're thrilled to announce the release of Update 1.1.3.2412 - creatively nammed the Arctic Legacy update! This update brings exciting new features and enhancements to elevate the survival experience for players. It introduces dynamic environmental changes, gameplay improvements, and a touch of visual polish to enrich the immersive world of Enen.  
[/p][h3]Key Highlights[/h3][list][*][p][b]Snow Storms in The Great North Biome:[/b] Players can now brace themselves for snowstorms, adding an extra layer of challenge and realism to the frozen expanse. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Snow Footprints in The Great North:[/b] Traversing the snow has never been more engaging, as footprints now track your journey through the icy wilderness. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Fire VFX:[/b] Updated all fire visual effects to look more realistic. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Survival Mechanics:[/b] The rate at which hunger, thirst, and spirit decrease has been reduced, giving players a more balanced survival challenge. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Expanded Resources in Paradise Valley:[/b] Two large caves in Paradise Valley now feature increased resources, rewarding exploration with valuable supplies. [/p][/*][*][p][b]A Fresh Loading Screen:[/b] A new loading screen enhances the visual experience as you prepare to dive back into the game. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Polished Text Prompts:[/b] Small refinements have been made to text prompts, ensuring smoother navigation and clearer communication throughout gameplay. [/p][/*][/list][p]
Please continue sending your feedback and we'll continue adding new things to the game. If you want to submit feedback or find a bug that needs squashing, please report it in our [url="https://discord.gg/rB7nEb2Ksh"]Discord [/url]through our ticketing system.[/p]

Two large caves in Paradise Valley now feature increased resources, rewarding exploration with valuable supplies.

notes.title: Odyssey Update
notes.content:
[h1]The Odyssy Update is now available![/h1]

If you were thinking about getting the game, now is a great time to do so as we are part of the Steam Spring Sale! From [b]March 14th until the 21st[/b], the game will be on sale for [b]30% off![/b] Make sure to check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/freedomgames/list/120455]Freedom Games' Steam Spring Sale[/url] page to pick up some great games to play.

Check out the patch notes below for a detailed breakdown of the changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40551025/32226a33a9ddf7b01f3231071d1d6baf2754553a.png[/img]

[b]The Great North Expansion:[/b]
[list]
[*] The Great North biome is now over twice its original size.
[/list]
[b]Explore Points of Interest:[/b]
[list]
[*] The Valley of Giants and The Great North feature fossils, decaying buildings, train tracks, and arctic outposts. Some of these locations can be rummaged through for rare collectibles.
[/list]
[b]Ultra Rare Collectibles:[/b]
[list]
[*] Collect rare items to craft modern conveniences like a refrigerator and heater.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40551025/7677bb080e6faf457844507a3692f7479d3342c0.png[/img]

[b]Unlocking New Horizons:[/b]
[list]
[*] Crafting key statues on pedestals near teleporters is now required to unlock levels.
[*] Statue recipes unlock in the survival crafting menu post Stone of Knowledge absorption.
[/list]
[b]Survival Gets Nutritious:[/b]
[list]
[*] Introducing a nutrition system.
[*] Monitor protein, fat, and carbohydrate levels to avoid malnutrition.
[*] New recipes including baked beans, rendered fat, and fatty stew.
[/list]
[b]Composting Advancements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Composter mechanic lets players create compost overnight.
[*] More organic items can be added to the composter.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40551025/56335bd5c9b1fd552e6be0e38127eb146eb68ceb.png[/img]

[b]Craftable Comfort:[/b]
[list]
[*] Sleeping bag added to craftable items.
[*] Provides a safer and healthier place to rest in a base earlier in the game.
[/list]
[b]Solar Heater Innovation:[/b]
[list]
[*] Craftable with ultra rare collectibles.
[*] Provides 24/7 heat when turned on in a base.
[/list]
[b]Luxury Decor Pack:[/b]
[list]
[*] Craftable luxury items including vases, pedestal, console, and a cabinet with 50 storage capacity.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40551025/92d9ad0c6356f3eedf79bfdf2a864adcbda5a077.png[/img]

[b]Refrigerator Revamp:[/b]
[list]
[*] Refrigerator operates without requiring ice.
[/list]
[b]Building Item Retrieval:[/b]
[list]
[*] Players now get back 100% of building items on demolition.
[*] Crafting menu items still return 50% until the player levels up.
[/list]
[b]Sleeping Effects Overhaul:[/b]
[list]
[*] Exaggerated health effects based on bed or shelter type.
[/list]
[b]Enhanced Navigation:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new detailed map with more hints for improved navigation.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40551025/4a9443c80304276500a0bbbed013889d8c9b40f4.png[/img]

[b]Game Rebalancing:[/b]
[list]
[*] Edited food resources, respawn times, and AI spawn rates and locations.
[*] Removed bears and added wolves to The Valley of Giants in order to increase AI immersion and balance resource management.
[*] Bear pop-up still triggers when sleeping in a basic shelter.
[*] Increased the rate of spirit level increase during mediation.
[/list]
[b]Enhancements & Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Upgraded the main menu, prologue, and epilogue artwork with new story art.
[*] Updated water material for better above-water visibility.
[*] New textures for UI and pop-up menus for enhanced legibility.
[*] Replaced storage chest interaction sound with a less abrasive alternative.
[*] Decreased loading times on game load and level load.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Resolved collision issues with stairs causing player entrapment.
[*] Adjusted collision on multiple craftable furniture pieces.
[*] Fixed bug where the UI showed players starting at level one instead of "x" on day one.
[*] Beds now craft on triangular floor and foundation pieces.
[*] Fixed flickering issues on distant islands especially in the rain.
[*] Addressed floating vegetation in The Valley of Giants and rendering issues in The Great North.
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40551025/7a7ba7a5d9a517b10dc520f0d8d3abaa4eb7d049.png[/img]

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/rB7nEb2Ksh]Discord [/url] to hang out with the community, submit feedback, or report a bug through our ticketing system. We would also greatly appreciate you leaving a review on Steam with your honest thoughts of the game! The more feedback we receive the more ideas we can look at to add to the game in the future.

Thank you for your continued support and we look forward to you all continuing your adventures in our virtual world.

The Dev Team

notes.title: Welcome to Paradise
notes.content:
[h1]The Paradise Update is now available![/h1]

To celebrate the new update, Retreat to Enen will be [u][b]50% off[/b][/u] starting 1 PM EDT today through November 8th! This update brings a series of significant technical enhancements and gameplay refinements. Check out the patch notes below for a detailed breakdown of the changes.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40551025/c5618134a408c5752569c0c0a9754ac73345fda4.png[/img]
[b]Hypothermia Prevention Enhancement:[/b]
[list]
[*] Enabled players to use the snowsuit for hypothermia prevention in non-arctic biomes and at any time of day.
[*] Integrated this feature into gameplay mechanics.
[/list]
[b]New Biome Integration:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new biome that unlocks after completing the main story.
[*] Functionality to enable this biome upon story completion.
[/list]
[b]Nighttime Bear Threat:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a chance of a night-time bear attack if players sleep outside of a shelter in the redwoods biome.
[*] Merged this gameplay feature with the codebase.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40551025/883d3691f73ff4fd7cb3781b4e2700cf43f84d62.png[/img]
[b]Building System Expansion:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a yurt structure to the building system.
[*] Incorporated yurt-related code and assets into the repository.
[/list]
[b]Indoor Staircase Inclusion:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new indoor staircase option to the building system.
[*] Integrated staircase functionality into the repository.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40551025/fe290261955ecb290e2e0ef55e9e2879449c074b.png[/img]
[b]Ammunition Management:[/b]
[list]
[*] Arrows now break upon being fired.
[*] Included this functionality within the gameplay mechanics.
[/list]
[b]Spirit Mechanic Optimization:[/b]
[list]
[*] Modified the spirit mechanic to disable quantum control only when it reaches zero.
[*] Implemented logic to enforce this new mechanic.
[/list]
[b]Ruin Mechanic Enhancement:[/b]
[list]
[*] Replaced guided meditations with the absorption of Stones of Knowledge.
[*] Integrated Stone of Knowledge functionality into the game's logic.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40551025/85cc64455f92d56521eef0a62c05879cacbc1dab.png[/img]
[b]Spear Animation Refinement:[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated the spear animation for quicker strikes.
[*] Incorporated the optimized animation into the repository.
[/list]
[b]Death Animation Overhaul:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new death animation for enhanced realism.
[*] Integrated the new death animation into the game's asset pipeline.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40551025/4a9443c80304276500a0bbbed013889d8c9b40f4.png[/img]
[b]Foliage Handling Improvement:[/b]
[list]
[*] Implemented a mechanism for smaller foliage to despawn when crafting survival items on top of them.
[*] Integrated this logic into the game codebase.
[/list]
[b]HUD Improvement:[/b]
[list]
[*] Resolved a bug related to overlapping screens in the HUD.
[*] Updated the HUD codebase to address this issue.
[/list]
[b]Loading Performance Optimization:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved loading performance across the game.
[*] Integrated performance optimizations into the repository.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40551025/7a7ba7a5d9a517b10dc520f0d8d3abaa4eb7d049.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=eOzmVc6fjEY;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for your continued support and we look forward to you all continuing your adventures in our virtual world.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.9
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
We've heard from you all that there were a few bugs introduced with our latest patch. We've fixed some of those issues in this new one. Definitely let us know if you encounter anything else. Don't forget to leave a review here on Steam letting us know your thoughts on the game! Now onto the fixes...

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Memory/Performance issues caused by dropped inventory items that were duplicating when you left a cave and then returned. 
[*] You are now able to enter the caves that you may not have been able to previously unless you were closer than when the text prompts were discovered.
[/list]

Please continue sending your feedback and we'll continue adding new things to the game. If you want to submit feedback or find a bug that needs squashing, please report it in our [url=https://discord.gg/rB7nEb2Ksh]Discord [/url]through our ticketing system.

You are now able to enter the caves that you may not have been able to previously unless you were closer than when the text prompts were discovered.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.8
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 
We've been working on this big patch for you all over the past couple weeks and are very excited to finally bring it to you all! 

[h3]Fixes/Additions:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added brand new large cave systems to each biome.
[*] Added new ultra rare items to collect.
[*] Added new common collectibles.
[*] Updated the AI to be faster and more intuitive.
[*] Added a damage text prompt to AI.
[*] Updated the map to include the cave entrances.
[*] Added VFX to Enen and the redwoods that make the environment feel more alive.
[*] Allowed for more precise placement of crafted items.
[*] Added multiple plaques to each biome that help develop lore and guide the player.
[*] Ice can now be stored in the refrigerator.
[*] Added two new decorative items to craft.
[*] Added wooden porch beams to the building system.
[*] Decorative ceramics can now be placed on triangular foundation pieces.
[*] Navigation flags are now unlocked on the first day of survival.
[*] All loot chests can now be destroyed with a yield of 4 wood.
[*] Updated multiple inventory icons.
[*] Fixed a bug where doors were not placed on the stone doorway properly.
[*] Fixed a bug where poisoned arrows were not shooting if no regular arrows are in the players inventory
[/list]

Please continue sending your feedback and we'll continue adding new things to the game. If you want to submit feedback or find a bug that needs squashing, please report it in our [url=https://discord.gg/rB7nEb2Ksh]Discord [/url]through our ticketing system.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.7
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 
It's been a little bit since our last patch, but today we're bringing yall a big patch to make up for it! Please keep the feedback coming and we'll keep implementing it and making the game even better! If you want to submit feedback or find a bug that needs squashing, please report it in our [url=https://discord.gg/wdfRxBHeaN]Discord [/url]through our ticketing system. 

[h3]Additions/Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added color coded flag icons.
[*] Added 13 new base building pieces in 3 new styles and updated the floor strip model.
[*] Added 8 new craftable items including 5 paintings, a firewood rack for wood storage, an area rug, compost bin, and the statue of courage.
[*] Added a mechanic that highlights collectible items when your spirit is at a higher threshold.
[*] Added two new rare stones and ability upgrades.
[*] Added a new resource to collect.
[*] Added 12 new loot chests.
[*] Adjusted the meditation mechanic so that health, hunger and thirst do not drain while meditating.
[*] Changed the demolition mechanic so that all items are drained straight into inventory without the explosion mechanic.
[*] Added additional tutorial text prompts.
[*] Added descriptive text pop ups to all collectable items, crafting, and crafting items.
[*] Adjusted multiple variables to better balance the gameplay experience.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the crab pot was not working for some players.
[*] Fixed an issue where corner roof pieces would not craft over floor strips.
[*] Fixed an issue where meat was not rotting in storage containers.
[*] Fixed an issue where demolishing the snow pod was giving full oysters back.
[*] Fixed an issue where dropped oyster shells are sometimes rendered with meat.
[*] Fixed an issue where items were harvesting no yield if inventory was full.
[*] Fixed an issue where “ruins activated” was triggering after completing all 9 ruins.
[*] Optimized performance of base building.
[*] Fixed an issue where players were getting stuck in large trees in The Great North.
[*] Added a new sun for better sun visibility.
[*] Assigned tools to numerical hotkeys.
[*] Shortened the quantum control engaged vocal prompt.
[*] Fixed an issue where some loot chests were not opening underwater
[*] Made small storage chests stackable by snapping them together when crafting.
[*] Lowered the overall RAM and VRAM usage, which will fix crashing issues some players are encountering.
[*] Made storage containers snap to each other vertically when crafting.
[*] Fixed a memory leak issue some players were experiencing.
[*] Disabled the ability to build rain catchers and fire pits on foundations.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.5
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
We've implemented some more of the awesome feedback you all of been sending to us since launch. We greatly appreciate everyones investment and excitement for the game! Today's biggest update: [b]we've added a map[/b]!! We know this has been like the #1 request since launch and we're happy to finally add it for you. We've got some other exciting changes like an updated ending to the game and a new statue you can build from rare gems. 
Hopefully you all enjoy this update! If you have any issues, or want to send more suggestions, join our [url=https://discord.gg/wdfRxBHeaN]Discord [/url]and use the appropriate channels for either! Please also consider leaving us a review if you haven't already! 
Now onto the notes 😊

[h3]Additions/Fixes: [/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a map that the player can reference to get a general idea of where the ruins are. 
[*] Added loot chests to the map.
[*] Updated the ending of the game so that it spits you back out at the beginning teleporter instead of the main menu. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the canister was draining the flask when used
[*] Fixed an issue where planters would spawn a default cube when they do not have anything planted in them.
[*] Added a toggle to turn on and off flag icons
[*] Reduced the rate that fires burn by 30%
[*] Fixed an issue where pinned recipes were not updating
[*] Added multilayered text prompts to bottom left of screen when animals were harvested that provide more than one ingredient.
[*] Added 3 rare stones to the game. One in each map. They can be found in one lootchest in each map. The Earth stone on enen decreases the rate your spirit drops by 20%. The Heart stone in the valley of giants decreases the rate your health drops by 20%. The Fire stone in the great north gives you back 100% of your loot when you demolish items.
[*] Added a statue you can build with the rare gemstones. It unlocks after the lastmeditation is complete.
[*] Added large driftwood logs to maps along the edge of bodies of water. They can be harvested with quantum control for a large yield of sticks.
[*] Added large rocks you can demolish for a large yield of rocks
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.4
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 
Happy Monday! We wanted to start the week off right with another patch. If you're still experiencing issues that we haven't fixed yet, please be sure to report them in our [url=https://discord.gg/wdfRxBHeaN]Discord [/url]through the ticketing system. 
Thank you all for your support throughout our first full week of being launched! Please consider leaving us a review if you haven't already. It really helps us out. Plus we love reading through yalls feedback and seeing how we can improve the game! 

[h3]Fixes and Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the day night cycle was too fast in some saves. The bug fix adds about 10 minutes of daylight to most player’s games.
[*] Balanced gameplay by lowering the drain rate on hunger and spirit.
[*] Fixed a bug where small smoked meats were as nutritious as large smoked meats.
[*] Fixed an issue where walls, doorways, windows and railings were not snapping to triangular foundation pieces properly.
[*] Added a scrambled egg to the recipe menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.3
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 
Today we have another patch for you before going into the weekend! We're still working through some of the bugs reported in [url=https://discord.gg/wdfRxBHeaN]Discord [/url]and here in Steam discussions. Please continue reporting bugs and feedback in our [url=https://discord.gg/wdfRxBHeaN]Discord [/url]through the ticketing system. 
In this update we've added the flag icons to the screen to help show where you've placed them in the world. This was a huge request from you all and we're excited to be able to bring it to you all. As always please consider leaving your feedback as a review for us. We love hearing yalls feedback, plus it really helps us out! 

[h3]Fixes and Changes[/h3] 
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the day night cycle would slow down after 15 days or more of survival.
[*] Fixed an issue where square and triangular floor/roof pieces were not snapping properly above the players head.
[*] Added visual flag icons to the navigation flags when crafted.
[*] Fixed an issue where the headlamp was occasionally functioning prior to being crafted.
[*] Increased small and large storage container capacity.
[*] Added a windowed mode
[/list]

notes.title: October Dev Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We just wanted to update you on what we are currently working on. 

[h3]Biomes[/h3]
Retreat To Enen features multiple biomes that the player can travel to from the main island of Enen. We are currently working on the huge old growth forest. The biome features dense trees, lakes, open meadows and will be a terrific area to hunt for large game such as deer and elk. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40551025/b0728e34f2e7b5688bf08051a89313c6fe1542c3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40551025/43fc7987f05ec9be89f74f675244bf9ab9eac149.png[/img]

[h3]Hunting[/h3]
Speaking of, we are also in the midst of adding AI and bow hunting to the game. We want the hunting to be challenging but not frustrating. Big game will be fairly common, but the player must be careful not to startle them and it could take some time to find a large animal in the huge forests. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40551025/388f1530dd8a63cc8a611dfcc6d0eb19e1b3ebd1.png[/img]

[h3]Base Building[/h3]
We have also implemented the majority of base building. The player will have to level up to unlock all pieces. The building starts with more primitive clay walls and eventaully will advance to concrete and glass. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40551025/ec4718791f5dd88caa85be47f0244daddc468c2d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40551025/93ca66b8b37df0324c4de6000a4ab1820d5b8300.png[/img]

Thank you all for your support so far throughout development! Definitely wishlist the game if you haven't already. Follow us on socials ([url=https://twitter.com/RetreatToEnen]Twitter[/url]) as well as join our [url=https://discord.gg/wdfRxBHeaN]Discord [/url]for the latest updates
